name: Wallet Connection
summary: Visitors connect their own Solana wallet (Phantom, Solflare, Backpack, …) and pay your paid API from it, approving each payment in the wallet. Devnet only.

env.note: Devnet RPC the browser uses to build wallet payments. NEXT_PUBLIC_ values are visible to everyone, so never put a key here

prerequisites: A Solana browser wallet (Phantom, Solflare, Backpack, …) switched to devnet, holding devnet USDC from https://faucet.circle.com (no real money)
